stock.description: Web3 Meta Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily specializing in the provision of automated digital advertising solutions. Its comprehensive suite of services includes internet advertising agency work, encompassing ad placements on streaming platforms, search engine marketing, and sophisticated applied marketing and navigation campaigns. Beyond advertising, the firm also supports online game promotions and offers technical assistance for mobile payment systems. Established in 1988, the company was initially known as Odella Leather Holdings Limited before adopting the name Million Stars Holdings Limited in May 2017. Its headquarters are located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
